characters.summary: Zubat is a dual-type Poison/Flying bat Pokémon that relies on echolocation to navigate and locate prey in pitch-black environments. In combat, it utilizes aerial agility, biting techniques that can drain vitality, and status-inflicting sound-based or poison attacks to disorient and wear down opponents.

sources.supports: Zubat abilities, type, combat techniques, evolution, and general characteristics across games and anime.
Zubat is a Poison/Flying bat with no eyes that navigates by echolocation and is sensitive to bright light.
Zubat is weak to Electric, Ice, Psychic and Rock, immune to Ground, and has Inner Focus and Infiltrator.
Zubat learns Supersonic, Leech Life, Bite, Poison Fang and Air Slash.
